name: Notion Skills
summary: Official Notion Agent Skills for the Notion CLI (notion-cli) and scaffolding Notion Apps (notion-apps). MIT (LICENSE.md).
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Notion Labs, Inc.). The makenotion/skills repository is MIT via LICENSE.md (Copyright (c) 2026 Notion Labs, Inc.; there is no root LICENSE file; GitHub SPDX is MIT), not archived. Pushed 2026-09-22; this is an official pack, not a new 2026-11 launch. The pack is free to install; using notion-cli or Notion Apps against a Notion workspace needs a Notion account and follows Notion's own product terms (not re-verified here). This skills entry does not set mcp_endpoint (see notion-mcp for the MCP server). Documented install, recommended via the skills CLI, is `npx skills add makenotion/skills` or `npx skills add makenotion/skills --skill notion-cli` (not run). Two skills: notion-cli (install and use the Notion CLI `ntn` for workers, public API requests and file uploads) and notion-apps (scaffold and build Notion Apps, including workflows and database syncs). No CLI install or workspace access was used.
